name: wizard-frontend-boilerplate-pro
description: Scaffold a fully themed, production-ready frontend app in one session. Supports 5 frameworks (Next.js 15, React+Vite, Vue 3.5+, Nuxt 4, SvelteKit/Svelte 5) and 13 UI libraries (shadcn/ui, MUI, Chakra, Mantine, Ant Design, HeroUI, HeadlessUI, DaisyUI, Bootstrap, Vuetify, PrimeVue, Element Plus, custom Tailwind). 7-phase workflow: interview → version resolution → scaffold → OKLCH palette (8 named presets + custom hex/oklch) → 28 UI components → sidebar showcase with collapsible code snippets → end-to-end verification. Light/dark mode with FOUC prevention, Tailwind v4 (auto-fallback to v3), WCAG AA contrast gate, TypeScript or JavaScript, any package manager. Pairs with ui-ux-pro-max for higher-fidelity components — auto-falls back to built-in Tailwind implementations when absent. Plain CommonMark only; compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and 10+ other agents.
